title: Choice
summary: A form field that picks one option, or several, from cards in three layouts: list (one frame of rows, delivery and payment), tile (plans, modules) and picture (templates with an image). Each card has a name, a badge, a description, a price and term, and the real radio or checkbox on its name line. One option is a radio group the arrow keys move through; several are checkboxes. A chosen card has a 2 px primary edge over the lowest primary fill; invalid cards an error edge and a message under them.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

multiple.description: Several options: the cards are checkboxes in a group. Without it one option is chosen, the cards are a radio group.

appearance.description: cards: the options as cards in a layout of tile, list or picture (C28). list (owner decision C165 (1)): the ready group of checks or radios -- the label as a heading (text 1, medium) with its «*» and «?», the hint under it, each option a row of the class checkbox or radio (as sf-checkbox and sf-radio draw them: 40 at size 1, 60 with a caption as its description; only the control and its words are the target), and the error under the last row with the error icon; an option's icon, badge, price, term and image are not drawn. The value, the form, the keys and the events are the same in both.

layout.description: How the cards stand (owner decision C28). tile: cards in the grid, the control at the end of the name line, name, description and price on one left edge, the price at the foot after a divider (plans, modules). list: one frame of rows divided by lines, the control at the start, price and term a column at the end of the name line (delivery, payment); columns does not apply. picture: tiles whose image runs to the edges, the caption under it and the control at the end of the caption's name line; in a field narrower than 30rem (a phone) each tile is a row, the image at its start.

flow.description: How the rows of appearance list stand (C165 (3)); read only under list, layout stays the cards'. auto -- a row for up to three short options (a name of at most 20 characters, no caption), else a column; row -- side by side, --sf-space-1 apart (C105 H6), wrapping where they do not fit and a column in a field narrower than 24rem (the container step g2: a phone, while a form's half column keeps the row); column -- one under another.

columns.description: The grid of tile and picture: auto fills the width with cards no narrower than --sf-choice-min-inline-size (15rem); a number is the most columns, fewer where a card would be narrower than that, so a phone stacks them. A list is one column.

label.description: The visible name of the field over the cards; it names the group. Without it the host's aria-label does.

hint.description: The line under the cards; it describes the group.

help.description: The explanation behind a «?» (sf-help-mark, C133's look) after the label (C153 (8), C165 (1)): size 1/3, --sf-space-1/4 after it, held to the label's line so the line keeps its height. The mark is named by its subject («Подробнее: <label>», lang runtime help). Empty: no mark.

name.description: The form name: one entry with the chosen value, or one entry per chosen value when multiple.

required.description: The form is not sent while nothing is chosen (value-missing).

disabled.description: No card can be chosen or focused, and nothing is sent with the form; a disabled fieldset does the same. An option's own disabled turns off its card alone.

invalid.description: The page's verdict: the cards not chosen take the error edge, aria-invalid is set, and error-message shows under them.

error-message.description: Shown in place of the hint while invalid.

value.description: The chosen option's value; multiple, the chosen values joined by commas in the order of the options ('' when nothing is). The value attribute is the default a form reset returns to; set from code (a string, or a list of values) it says nothing. The property selected gives the values as a list.

items.description: The options, [{value, label, caption?, icon?, badge?, price?, term?, image?, disabled?}]: each a card with its name (label, or title), a description under it (caption), an icon on the name line, a short badge (sf-badge) beside the name, a price and its term (list: a column at the end of the name line; tile and picture: the foot of the card, after a divider) and an image (picture: to the card's edges, over the caption). A property, the JSON island or the attribute as JSON. An option without a value or repeating one is left out.

input.summary: A person chose an option or, multiple, turned one off. Sent before change, with the same detail; the inner inputs' own events do not leave the host.

change.summary: The value changed by the person, once per press, as a native radio group's or checkbox's: detail.value is the new value, detail.values the chosen values, detail.item the option pressed, detail.checked whether it is chosen now. A value set from code, a form reset and a restore say nothing.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: drawing cards of its own over the field
trusting the submitted values without checking them on the server

keyboard: Single: Tab reaches the chosen card (or the first); the arrow keys move to the next or previous card and choose it, wrapping at the ends
Multiple: Tab reaches each card; Space turns it on or off
accessibility.focus: The focus ring is drawn on the card whose input has keyboard focus; a press draws none.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-input-choice to pick one or several of a few options shown all at once: as cards (appearance cards) where the options need words to tell apart -- a site's kind, a page type, a template, a field type, a backup target, a plan; as a ready group of checks or radios (appearance list) for a question with a heading, a hint and one error -- a buyer's kind, notifications, a payment way.
do_not: Do not use it for a long list; use sf-input-select or sf-input-lookup
Do not build a group of sf-radio or sf-checkbox with a heading and an error of your own; use appearance list
Do not draw cards of your own with radios inside; give the options to the field
ai_guidance.minimal_example: <sf-input-choice label="Тип сайта" name="kind" items='[{"value": "site", "label": "Сайт", "caption": "Страницы и разделы", "icon": "language"}, {"value": "shop", "label": "Магазин", "caption": "Каталог и заказы", "icon": "storefront"}]'></sf-input-choice>
